I have conducted a deep engineering assessment of the repository to identify discrepancies between [docs/api.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-8scA3R/workspace/docs/api.md) and the implementation in [src/api.js](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-8scA3R/workspace/src/api.js) & [src/limit.js](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-8scA3R/workspace/src/limit.js). The findings have been written to [ASSESSMENT.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-8scA3R/workspace/ASSESSMENT.md) without modifying any existing source code or documentation files.

### Summary of What Was Verified

1. **Test Execution**: Ran `npm test` (`node --test test/limit.test.js`), confirming the single existing rate-limiting test passes.
2. **Authentication Discrepancy**: Verified `docs/api.md` specifies Bearer token auth returning `401`, but `src/api.js` has no auth middleware.
3. **Endpoint Versioning Mismatch**: Verified `docs/api.md` documents `/v1/events`, while `src/api.js` registers `/v2/events` (resulting in `404` for `/v1` calls).
4. **Pagination Contract Mismatch**: Verified `docs/api.md` specifies offset pagination (`?page=2`, 50/page), whereas `src/api.js` implements cursor pagination (`?after=<id>`, 25/page).
5. **POST Behavior Mismatch**: Verified `src/api.js` requires an undocumented `idempotency-key` header (400 if missing), returning status `202` and `{ accepted: true }` instead of `201` with the created event body.
6. **Rate Limiting Mismatch & Memory Leak**: Verified `docs/api.md` states 100 req/min per token, while code limits 600 req/min per IP (`req.ip`), and `src/limit.js` leaks memory by retaining empty IP keys in its `hits` Map.
